generation_notes: Generate artwork only. Compose for readability at trading-card thumbnail size: one dominant focal subject, bold silhouette, controlled background detail, and a single immediately legible action or joke. Do not add a card frame, card title, rules text, labels, logos, signatures, borders, or watermarks. Bounding boxes use Ideogram's normalized 0-1000 coordinate space.

prompt.high_level_description: A Fiend-type MONSTER card artwork from the Ledgendaries archetype. In a close, low-angle action portrait, a tiny goblin junior clerk races directly toward the viewer while balancing a dangerously tall stack of quest-expense scrolls.

style_description.lighting: warm morning light through cathedral windows, complemented by green magical ink and golden desk lamps
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, polished high-fantasy monster artwork played completely seriously, dominant central silhouette, exaggerated perspective, expressive character acting and crisp ornamental detail, no visible writing or typography

compositional_deconstruction.background: A softly defocused cathedral-like administrative hall recedes behind the subject, with a few desks, brass scroll tubes and fleeing clerk silhouettes supporting the action without competing for attention.

elements.desc: Pips fills most of the square frame in a foreshortened sprint. His bright-green face, enormous alarmed amber eyes and crooked spectacles form the focal point; one oversized shoe and one stamping hand thrust toward the viewer. His burgundy waistcoat and loose necktie stream backward.

A single teetering column of blank parchment curls in a strong S-shaped arc above and behind Pips, framing his silhouette. One tiny forbidden artifact glows inside an accidentally approved folder near the top.
A few blurred quills, ink drops and clerk silhouettes streak outward from the central running path, reinforcing speed while leaving Pips unmistakably dominant.

prompt.high_level_description: A Warrior-type MONSTER card artwork from the Ledgendaries archetype. A magnificent armored knight collides diagonally with a demonic treasure-chest mimic in a close, explosive dispute over a cursed transaction.

style_description.lighting: radiant white-gold light from the knight's stamped shield clashes with crimson light from the cursed chest
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, dramatic high-fantasy battle painting with elegant armor, forceful action, refined magical effects and deadpan bureaucratic comedy, no visible writing or typography

compositional_deconstruction.background: A dark claims chamber is reduced to blurred marble counters, one velvet rope and streaking shelves of confiscated artifacts, keeping all attention on the central collision.

elements.desc: Sir Chargeback lunges from lower left to upper right, filling most of the frame. Ivory-and-burgundy armor, a foreshortened silver sword and a large receipt-shaped shield form one clean triangular silhouette.

The mimic surges from the opposite diagonal with its lid open as a tooth-filled jaw. Its face overlaps the knight's shield rather than occupying a separate scene, while coins and red curse smoke trail behind it.
At the exact center, the shield strikes the mimic's curse and produces one brilliant circular approval seal. The ring frames both faces and sends only a few coins and blank forms toward the edges.

prompt.high_level_description: A Reptile-type MONSTER card artwork from the Ledgendaries archetype. In a close creature portrait, a small bespectacled basilisk guards a petty-cash box while its emerald gaze petrifies an adventurer just outside the frame.

style_description.lighting: soft amber office light with a sharp emerald petrification glow reflected across coins and stone
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, polished creature-focused fantasy art with tactile scales, expressive posing, clean silhouettes and serious cinematic presentation of an absurd situation, no visible writing or typography

compositional_deconstruction.background: A softly shadowed treasury counter with a few drawers, coin scales and bundled receipts forms a simple vignette behind the creature.

elements.desc: The cat-sized basilisk dominates the frame in three-quarter view. Glossy green scales, half-moon spectacles, bright emerald eyes and a burgundy bow tie create a strong compact silhouette. One claw rests sternly on a brass cash box while its curling tail encloses three coins.
Only the adventurer's frightened face, empty hand and forearm enter from the right edge. Gray stone spreads across the fingers as a useless blank receipt slips away.
A narrow emerald gaze beam connects the basilisk's eyes to the petrifying hand, creating the main diagonal and visually explaining the joke instantly.

prompt.high_level_description: A Dragon-type MONSTER card artwork from the Ledgendaries archetype. A five-headed hydra middle manager rises in a powerful radial portrait, with every neck conducting a different contradictory meeting.

style_description.lighting: cool crystal-projector light from below with warm brass chandeliers and violet magical presentation beams
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, elaborate fantasy ensemble composition with imposing dragon anatomy, animated expressions, layered depth and dignified bureaucratic absurdity, no visible writing or typography

compositional_deconstruction.background: A dark vaulted executive chamber and the curved edge of one conference table remain subordinate to the hydra, with a brass clock forming a subtle halo behind the central head.

elements.desc: One broad teal dragon torso in a tailored burgundy waistcoat anchors the center. Five long necks curve outward like the spokes of a wheel, giving the monster an instantly readable radial silhouette. Each expressive head wears a different necktie and appears enthusiastic, furious, confused, sleepy or smug.
Each head points toward one small floating geometric diagram, and the five incompatible diagrams form a restrained ring of cyan and violet magic around the body without obscuring it.
The conference table appears only as a foreground crescent. Three tiny exhausted clerks look upward while one hydra head rings a brass meeting bell.

prompt.high_level_description: A Fiend-type MONSTER card artwork from the Ledgendaries archetype. A wooden filing-cabinet mimic lunges out of a dark archive, its largest drawer opening toward the viewer as a ravenous foreshortened mouth.

style_description.lighting: a warm desk lamp creates cozy office light while an unnatural violet glow leaks from the cabinet's opening jaws
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, polished fantasy creature rendering with convincing wood and brass materials, expressive suspense, controlled magical effects and visual comedy, no visible writing or typography

compositional_deconstruction.background: A narrow archive aisle converges behind the monster in deep shadow, with shelves reduced to simple vertical shapes and one green lamp outlining the silhouette.

elements.desc: The mahogany cabinet fills the square and tilts violently toward the viewer. Two upper drawers become glaring eyes while the huge lower drawer forms a foreshortened mouth whose folder-tab teeth nearly touch the front of the image. Brass fittings and violet inner light define its silhouette.
Only the clerk's upper body enters from the left edge, recoiling with a blank folder held between both hands as the mimic's ribbon tongue curls around it.
Three flying folders, one bent quill and an abandoned necktie radiate from the open mouth, reinforcing the attack without turning the scene into background clutter.

prompt.high_level_description: A Dragon-type MONSTER card artwork from the Ledgendaries archetype. In a near-symmetrical boss portrait, the colossal Grand Auditor dragon delivers final judgment beneath a radiant celestial abacus.

style_description.lighting: towering stained-glass windows cast burgundy and gold shafts through blue ink-like magical haze, with a white radiance behind the dragon's abacus halo
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, premium boss-monster fantasy rendering with enormous scale, sophisticated anatomy, intricate regalia, atmospheric perspective and solemn bureaucratic comedy, no visible writing or typography

compositional_deconstruction.background: A dark cathedral office recedes into blue haze behind the dragon. Two stained-glass windows and descending ledger shelves create a symmetrical frame without competing with the boss silhouette.

elements.desc: The Grand Auditor's head, armored torso and immense burgundy-robed shoulders occupy almost the entire frame. His navy-scaled face looks downward through half-moon spectacles; ledger-page wings spread beyond the left and right edges, and one claw raises a glowing brass stamp toward the viewer.
A huge brass abacus forms a clean circular halo behind the dragon's crown. Its luminous beads orbit like planets while one red and one blue stream of magical ink curve around the shoulders.
At the very bottom, tiny silhouettes of a king, hero and nervous deity emphasize the dragon's scale while remaining visually subordinate.

prompt.high_level_description: A Field SPELL card artwork from the Ledgendaries archetype. A monumental fantasy government headquarters rises around one unmistakable central rotunda where adventurers submit magical quest expenses.

style_description.lighting: golden daylight pours through vaulted windows while blue-green administrative magic travels through brass tubes
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, extremely detailed fantasy environment art with readable spatial hierarchy, lively miniature storytelling and grand cinematic scale, no visible writing or typography

compositional_deconstruction.background: A palatial administrative complex uses strong one-point perspective toward a luminous central rotunda, with paired gothic archive towers and orderly balconies creating a legible symmetrical silhouette.

elements.desc: The central rotunda dominates the square like a fantasy basilica, crowned by a glass dome and a monumental balanced scale. Four spiral balconies and paired brass scroll tubes curve inward toward it.

A single serpentine queue leads from the foreground directly toward the rotunda. Readable silhouettes include one knight, one wizard with a smoking wand, one dragon holding a tiny token and one healer carrying blank forms.
Luminous coins, quills and sealed folders orbit the balanced scale in one restrained circular pattern, visually unifying the architecture.

prompt.high_level_description: A Continuous SPELL card artwork from the Ledgendaries archetype. One adventuring party and its ghostly accounting duplicate perform perfectly opposite actions across a glowing divide inside a mirrored dungeon chamber.

style_description.lighting: orange torchlight in the left dungeon mirrors cool cyan magical light in the right, meeting at a bright golden dividing line
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, intricate symmetrical fantasy composition with clear action, polished stone textures, magical accounting motifs and visual wit, no visible writing or typography

compositional_deconstruction.background: One square dungeon chamber is divided exactly in half by a luminous golden vertical axis. A chest, stair and single swinging trap repeat as clean mirrored shapes on both sides.

elements.desc: On the warm left half, three tightly grouped adventurers open one chest as coins burst upward and a single axe swings behind them.
On the cool right half, three translucent duplicates reverse the same poses while coins spiral back into a closed chest and the axe returns upward.
A narrow golden beam divides the scene. Pips rides a tiny brass platform at its center, holding two balanced blank ledger pages that overlap both halves.

style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, expressive fantasy scene with strong character acting, elegant spell effects, layered ensemble staging and understated comedy, no visible writing or typography

compositional_deconstruction.background: A council chamber falls into shallow focus behind the wizard, with only a curved table, warm torches and five blurred arguing silhouettes suggesting the unnecessary meeting.

elements.desc: The weary blue-robed wizard fills most of the frame, slumped toward the viewer with one hand covering his face. His other hand raises a tiny crystal close to eye level, creating a clear emotional focal point.
A cheerful cyan message sprite emerges from the crystal and projects one simple checkmark-shaped flare beside the wizard's disbelieving eye.
Five softly blurred officials continue arguing behind him around the crescent-shaped table, their gestures forming a loose circular frame rather than separate focal subjects.

prompt.high_level_description: An Equip SPELL card artwork from the Ledgendaries archetype. A legendary enchanted sword fills the frame like a sacred relic, but a thick office security chain fastens it to a mundane checkout counter.

style_description.lighting: divine gold-white radiance erupts from the sword while the surrounding office remains softly lit by ordinary green desk lamps
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, premium fantasy artifact rendering with radiant magical effects, meticulous metalwork, humorous scale contrast and no visible writing or typography

compositional_deconstruction.background: A softly blurred equipment counter and dark pegboard provide a simple neutral backdrop that makes the radiant weapon unmistakable at thumbnail size.

elements.desc: The silver greatsword occupies nearly the entire vertical frame at a slight diagonal. Its foreshortened wing-shaped guard, crystal pommel and radiant blade produce a heroic cross-shaped silhouette.
A heavy brass security chain wraps around the blade and curves down to the checkout counter, creating the comic contradiction without reducing the sword's grandeur.
Only two pairs of hands enter from opposite edges: armored hands reverently hold a blank checkout form while small green goblin hands point at a brass pocket watch.

style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, dramatic fantasy reveal with forceful perspective, expressive reactions, polished magical effects and bureaucratic menace, no visible writing or typography

compositional_deconstruction.background: One compact treasury chamber glows behind the inspectors, with a central treasure mound and two stone arches creating a clean stage for the ambush.

elements.desc: The backs and shocked profiles of three adventurers fill the immediate foreground. A treasure sack slips from one hand toward the viewer, making the audience share their discovery.
Pips, Sir Chargeback and the Petty-Cash Basilisk form one compact triangular inspection team behind a portable desk at the center of the vault, staring directly toward the adventurers.
A huge luminous red audit seal forms a circular frame around the inspection team while four strands of magical red tape snap shut across the treasure mound.

style_description.lighting: violent crimson ritual light collapses beneath a descending white-gold rejection stamp surrounded by blue administrative lightning
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, explosive counter-magic scene with crisp focal hierarchy, powerful spell effects, detailed ritual imagery and deadpan visual storytelling, no visible writing or typography

compositional_deconstruction.background: A dark mountaintop ritual platform and two broken pillars frame one crimson portal, leaving the center open for the collision of rejection magic and summoning energy.

elements.desc: The sorcerer occupies the lower diagonal with arms raised and robes whipping backward. A tiny incomplete blank form escapes from one sleeve, visible against the red portal light.
A colossal foreshortened brass-and-ivory stamp descends from the upper right, its broad base nearly facing the viewer as it crushes the dragon portal at the center.
The portal collapses into a single explosive ring of crimson fire and blue administrative lightning. The dragon's head is only half emerged and visibly compressed by the impact.

style_description.lighting: an infernal red sky and falling meteors contrast with a brilliant emerald approval beam and explosive showers of golden coins
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, maximalist fantasy action with strong central storytelling, dramatic environmental destruction, polished energy effects and earnest comedy, no visible writing or typography

compositional_deconstruction.background: A simplified silhouette of the Head Office tilts beneath a crimson sky containing three meteors and one dimensional crack, providing urgency without competing with Pips and the construct.

A golden rescue construct bursts from lower left to upper right, overlapping Pips's magical shockwave. Dragon wings, fortress armor, stacked shields and one unnecessary jeweled crown merge into a single bold silhouette.
One emerald approval beam connects the button to the construct while a restrained arc of golden coins frames the diagonal launch.

prompt.high_level_description: A Continuous TRAP card artwork from the Ledgendaries archetype. A gigantic semicircular dragon bite missing from a castle tower becomes the central visual joke while claims inspectors calmly measure the damage.

style_description.aesthetics: sunlit, methodical, absurdly calm, richly environmental
style_description.lighting: clear afternoon sunlight reveals warm stone dust, orange dragon fire and cool blue measuring magic
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, detailed fantasy environment storytelling with believable scale, lively characters, clean magical diagrams and restrained comedy, no visible writing or typography

compositional_deconstruction.background: A clean blue sky and distant green hills isolate one damaged stone tower, ensuring its enormous bite-shaped negative space reads immediately at card size.

elements.desc: A single castle tower fills the left and center of the frame. One enormous clean semicircular bite removes nearly half of it, exposing two tiny rooms and creating a powerful recognizable negative shape.
A large orange dragon sits tightly cropped at the right edge with folded arms, puffed cheeks and an impatient glare, delicately holding a tiny brass queue token between two claws.
Three very small inspectors hang around the bite on glowing blue measuring lines. Sir Chargeback holds one loose tooth near the lower edge, reinforcing scale without creating a second scene.

prompt.high_level_description: A Normal SPELL card artwork from the Ledgendaries archetype. An impossible spiral of heroic relics, magical red tape and administrative energy converges into one comically tiny open filing drawer and repairs reality.

style_description.lighting: a radiant rainbow-white burst pours from the drawer, illuminating the office against the dark coils of enchanted red tape
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, climactic ensemble fantasy art with emotional character acting, brilliant magical effects, clean composition and a satisfying visual punchline, no visible writing or typography

compositional_deconstruction.background: The records hall is reduced to dark radial architecture around a bright crack in reality, directing every line toward the tiny drawer at the central vanishing point.

elements.desc: A tiny mahogany filing drawer floats open at the exact center, viewed in dramatic perspective. Pips braces both feet against its edge while pushing one final golden approval seal inside.

A powerful clockwise spiral of one sword, one crown, one dragon tooth, coins, a broken wand and crimson red tape narrows rapidly toward the drawer. The limited set of large objects remains readable instead of becoming clutter.
Rainbow-white administrative light erupts upward from the drawer and stitches the dark crack in reality closed, transforming the final red-tape coil into a celebratory ribbon.
